name: Smoke test
description: Proves the whole machine works end to end: it logs, parks a prompt for Claude, transforms the answer, and writes a file.

config.message: Smoke test run {{ run.id }} started at {{ run.startedAt }}. Topic is {{ input.topic }}.

config.system: You write short plain English. No em dashes. Answer with the sentence only, no preamble and no sign off.
config.prompt: Give one short sentence about {{ input.topic }}. Plain English, no em dashes. Answer with the sentence only.

config.expression: (function(){ var t = String(steps.n2.output.text).trim(); var words = t.split(' ').filter(function(w){ return w.length > 0; }).length; return { topic: input.topic, text: t, words: words, chars: t.length, emDashFound: t.indexOf(String.fromCharCode(8212)) !== -1 }; } )()
